what_to_detect: A resolution whose instruction asks for N of something (cards discarded, permanents sacrificed) performs fewer than N because the rest is impossible, with the performed part still carried out; the record shows requested count in the acting line's script params versus the events and prior state.
near_miss: A resolution of the same API that performs the full requested count.

what_to_detect: A continuous effect that grants an ability or keyword to a permanent applies even though an earlier-timestamped effect removes abilities from it (the later effect wins by timestamp, not by "can't" precedence).
near_miss: An ability-removing continuous effect with a later timestamp than an ability grant on the same permanent removes the granted ability.
